chunks: And it is narrated from al-Riḍā عليه السلام that he said:
For salat (prayer), there are four thousand doors.

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةُ: four, part of the expression indicating abundance
key_terms.الرِّضَا: Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام, from whom this hadith is narrated
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the central act of worship being described
key_terms.بَابٍ: door, meaning a way, aspect, or avenue

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean when it says that salat has four thousand doors?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the vast excellence, dimensions, and pathways of salat (prayer). It indicates that salat possesses immense depth, benefit, and spiritual significance beyond what is outwardly apparent.
